design.decision: Once at 8, keep climbing: a 10 pays 100 against 80 for an 8. A set loses all of it.
design.opponent: Shown after bidding at 8 or more. Opponents fight hard to set a contract worth this much.
design.rationale: Compared with seed-bid8-points (flat 60, -1.8), this pays more for each trick past the threshold, so it rewards 9s and 10s. That is the scaling the bid-tension target asks for. Departure: scaling plus a threshold is two quantities, but both read in one familiar phrase.
design.draftText: +10 contract points for each trick in your team's contract when your team bids 8 or more

critic.concerns: Threshold plus scaling departure, but it reads in one familiar phrase.
